Fixed a blank screen or no answer at startup, and empty `claude mcp list` output, when a stored MCP sign-in record was null - Fixed the Artifact tool telling Claude to add filters when an artifact's database collection is too large to sort; it now says to read the collection page by page and sort the results - Fixed a restarted cloud session dropping a message with a large image when the restart came before Claude's first reply to it - Fixed a restarted cloud session leaving a subagent's message to the main conversation unanswered - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running - Improved the `/model` picker: "More models" is now an unnumbered row below every other, and older models open under it without renumbering the rest - Gateway: Improved spend limits on a busy replica, which now skips fewer checks and records spend sooner - Improved the Claude apps gateway's sign-in limit messages in Claude Code and on the `/device` page: they no longer name gateway settings, which the gateway's own log still names - Improved `claude install` and the install scripts: they finish 2 to 4 seconds sooner - Improved how soon a Remote Control session whose process crashed can pick up a new message - Windows: Improved startup and first-command time by finding programs on PATH without starting a helper process - Improved auto mode in headless sessions, the desktop app and VS Code: reports from background subagents that wait together are answered in one model call, as in the terminal - Improved the agent view's row for a `claude --bg --worktree` session that couldn't set up its worktree: it now shows the error from its beginning, not an internal tag or its last 200 characters - Improved the messages shown when an artifact is in another organization: `/login` is offered only if it's one of yours, and Claude now says where a copy may be after an account move - Improved sessions with more images than fit in one request: Claude is told whether it has already seen a dropped image, and repeat reads of an unchanged image are limited - Improved `claude remote-control`'s messages for an unanswered first-run question: each now says what to do next - Improved start-up time by loading trusted TLS certificates faster - Improved Claude apps gateway error messages to show the gateway's address without any user name or password - Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: the reset now shows in your local time, such as "resets 4pm (America/Los_Angeles)" - Windows: Improved startup time with a standard Git for Windows install by no longer checking which git.exe to run on every launch - Updated the session-feedback message and the `allowedProviders` setting description to name Ultra alongside Pro and Max, and the `forceLoginMethod` description to cover every paid Claude plan - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to suggest a list of meters, one row per item, for several ratios that each have their own limit - Updated the "Upgrade to Max" options to say "Upgrade to Max or Ultra" - Changed mods Claude writes to turn on without asking in auto and bypass modes, even with managed `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` or `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and not to load in `dontAsk` mode - Changed mods' own tool calls (`$.tool.call`, `$.mcp.call`) to raise no permission prompt, even under your own ask rules or in `dontAsk` and `-p` runs; deny rules and organization policy still apply - Changed saved Fable 5.1 model picks to move to `fable`: on Pro and Max plans at once, on Team and Enterprise plans once your organization allows it; use `/model claude-fable-5-1` to switch back - Changed the fast mode labels in `/fast`, `/config` and `/model` to name your current model when it supports fast mode, and removed "(Opus only)" from the VS Code row - Changed nested skill loading: `.claude/skills` folders inside `~/.claude/plugins` no longer load when Claude works on files there - Self-hosted runner: Changed an on-demand runner that the server refuses because it is not needed (session ended or paused, work order superseded) to exit 0 instead of 1 - Windows: Changed how Claude Code finds programs it starts itself, such as git, to skip relative and UNC PATH entries and links onto a network share, and to pick up PATH changes from settings - Changed OpenTelemetry hook events in non-interactive sessions to leave two built-in hooks out of `num_hooks` and `num_success` after Bash and PowerShell calls - Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 10 to 20 - Changed `AskUserQuestion` in `claude -p` and SDK sessions to deny a host's permission answer that sets the undocumented `afkTimeoutMs` input field - Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces`: a declared name can't be added from another source, an entry from elsewhere is hidden, and plugins the declared marketplace lists are reinstalled from it - Changed Claude in Chrome tools that an app running Claude Code provides, such as the Claude desktop app's Code tab, to follow your organization's Claude in Chrome policy - Changed `policy_mode: layered` in the Claude apps gateway: managed MCP servers now add up over every matching policy, `match: {}` included, so a gateway already on it serves more after the upgrade - Gateway: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry upstreams to ignore the `ANTHROPIC_*_BASE_URL` variables in the gateway's environment. Set `base_url` on the upstream to use another endpoint - Changed headless sessions to reload mods in `.claude/skills` when their files change; set `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=0` to turn this off - Changed the Cyber Verification Program sentence on a cyber safeguard block to use the same words as claude.ai - Changed Cowork cloud sessions: a PostToolUse hook can no longer replace the answer to AskUserQuestion or the plan in ExitPlanMode's result; Claude reads the originals - Changed `cp` and `mv` spelled by a path, such as `/bin/cp`, to get the same path checks as `cp` and `mv` - Changed background command notifications and TaskStop results to show Claude only the start and end of a command over 1,000 characters, which saves context - Changed artifact design guidance to treat Inter and Space Grotesk as good default typefaces - Changed the account email check to refuse only a shell command that holds your email and names a User-Agent, without asking, so other commands and scheduled runs no longer stop at its prompt - Changed Remote Control sessions to keep the folder they were started in: a connected client can no longer move a session to another folder - Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` take-overs from an undeclared source: saved data is set aside for `cleanupPeriodDays`, and options and secrets until `claude plugin restore-set-aside` - [VSCode] Added a warning above the prompt box when both an auth token and an API key are set, matching the terminal's startup warning - [VSCode] Fixed a plugin's permission request showing a name with hidden characters: it now reads "a plugin"

item.title: v2.1.319
item.description: - Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged) - Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too - Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes - Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND` environment variable to make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to the background right away - Added `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates - Added `/claude-api latency-optimize` to find where your Claude API code makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval - Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS` environment variable, which stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses its built-in default - Added spend for today, this week and this month to `/usage` for developers behind a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when the gateway runs this version or later - Added `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` and `admin.pooled_priority_order` to the Claude apps gateway, to set which pooled group budget pays first for a developer in several groups - Added an optional `login_notice` setting to the Claude apps gateway that shows an operator-defined message on the gateway's browser verification page and on Claude Code's sign-in screen - Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json` to the Claude apps gateway: operational log lines become JSON with `severity`, `time` and `message`, for log collectors that read the level from a field - Added a Claude apps gateway boot warning for a case where another policy's `availableModels` also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name - Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no `desktopHome` that rely on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change - Added a warning when your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on the sign-in from `ant auth login`, which bills usage to your Claude Console organization - Added a line at startup naming the Claude Console organization that is billed in a case where Claude Code uses the sign-in from `ant auth login` - Added an "Earlier in this session" row to `/tasks` that lists finished subagents, so you can reopen one and message it even after it leaves the list or you restart - Added a note to `/loop` confirmations in cloud sessions that a timer stops with its container, with an offer of a loop that survives - Fixed MCP servers on the older handshake failing to connect, or returning empty results, because Claude Code declared an extension that it only uses with newer servers - Fixed a long-running MCP tool call on a claude.ai connector sometimes never reporting its result after `--resume` - Fixed a session's diff failing to load on claude.ai and the mobile apps when the folder Claude Code runs in has a file or folder named `HEAD` - Fixed `/diff` showing "Diff unavailable" when a git repository has a file or folder named `HEAD` at its top level - Fixed the `/diff` pane opening blank in sessions where 64 or more turns edited files - Fixed slash commands typed after a leading space, tab or newline being sent to Claude as plain text instead of running - Fixed a request that kept failing with a 401 refreshing your login on every retry and causing 401s in your other sessions - Fixed `/context` sending its full visual grid to Claude on every later turn; Claude now reads only the table - Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 in auto mode when its actions were refused because no safety check was available: text and JSON output now exit 1 - Fixed a case where Claude Code listed every project file at start on Linux for projects on a network file system (NFS, SMB, Lustre and similar) - Fixed a case where auto mode was wrongly refused when a client sent a model change and a request for auto mode back to back - Fixed `/status` showing "Auto mode server: Enabled" when the server-side review isn't reaching the session, for example behind an LLM gateway that drops it - Fixed Claude-drafted feedback, surveys and `/feedback` continuing to appear after the server refused feedback for your organization - Fixed Claude drafting feedback on third-party gateways, where it can't be sent - Fixed auto mode refusing actions without saying why when permission rules or `autoMode` settings are very large: it now explains and, unless `autoMode` deny rules are set, asks you in the terminal - Fixed a case where Bash deny and ask rules missed commands written with quoted words - Fixed subagent hand-back reports showing an internal marker and provenance note when expanded outside verbose mode - Fixed `claude -p --resume` with a prompt losing a deferred tool call when its MCP server is missing: the run now exits 1, keeps the call and refuses later input - Fixed a case where text was dropped from informational messages sent to SDK clients - Fixed a case where Agent SDK hosts got a generic exit-code error instead of a failed run's own error message when the disk was full - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that was interrupted in plan mode when the session resumes in another permission mode - Fixed edits to a settings file being ignored when made within a few seconds of Claude Code writing that file - Fixed a config file left at the legacy name hiding your setup with no warning: Claude Code now says on stderr when a home holds two config files, and which is in use - Fixed `~/.claude.json`, settings and edited files ending up empty or cut off when the disk fills during a save in a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file (one session saving at a time) - Fixed Write ending the turn as a refusal when it couldn't read the file to overwrite - Fixed background Bash commands that finish almost instantly losing their output while being reported as completed - Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files missing a file that the command wrote just before it ended - Fixed a mistyped model name, such as `opus-5-5`, telling you to update Claude Code instead of suggesting the model you meant - Fixed a case where `NotebookEdit` changed the wrong cell when the notebook changed while a permission prompt was open - Fixed a ~0.5s hang after pressing Enter on the `/login` success screen: the dialog now dismisses immediately and the post-login refresh runs in the background - Fixed Ctrl+G not opening the external editor while typing an "Other" answer to a question in screen reader mode - Fixed Monitor's WebSocket watch failing with "could not resolve" behind a proxy when `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` is set and the machine has no DNS of its own - Fixed `claude plugin eval` warnings suggesting `max: 0` for a tool that must not be called, which could never pass - Fixed background plugin auto-update not installing a dependency added by the updated plugin version - Fixed Cmd+click not opening links in Ghostty over tmux in sessions opened from the agents view - Fixed a mod's hot reload in `.claude/skills` missing a file that was deleted just after it appeared, and missing its return - Fixed `/rewind` failing with "No files were restored" when restoring code to a checkpoint from before `/branch` - Fixed the `/claude-api` skill saying Console web settings don't apply to Managed Agents sessions, and tightened its credential and permission examples - Fixed needless permission prompts for read-only commands wrapped in a plain `timeout DURATION`, such as `timeout 30 rg foo` - Fixed WebFetch describing claude.ai shared-chat links as empty pages; it now says shared chats can't be read and to paste the conversation instead - Fixed Artifact database calls being re-sent to artifacts without a database; errors now say whether republishing helps - Fixed a case where artifact database reads that save to a folder (`out_dir`) were refused - Fixed detailed beta tracing not presenting `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT` to collectors that require a client certificate - Fixed the OpenTelemetry `claude_code.session.count` metric counting Agent SDK `prewarm()` processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts once, when it is claimed - Fixed `/clear` killing running commands of background agents, teammates and workflows that keep running, and foreground subagents of background agents and teammates - Fixed a terminal whose Claude apps gateway sign-in had expired sending telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway refused and logged as `invalid_token` - Fixed the agents view appearing to send a reply to a background session waiting on a permission prompt; the reply now stays in the box with a hint to open the session and answer - Fixed agent view removing a draft saved by another agent view in the same directory when exiting - Fixed a case where agent view came back with another agent view's input text after restarting itself for an update - Fixed the agents view preview cutting off long commands, results and status lines without an ellipsis, and dropping `**`, backticks and tags from commands waiting for approval - Fixed Claude in Chrome reporting the extension as not connected when the connection dropped mid-action; Claude now checks the page before repeating an action that may have run - Fixed Remote Control sessions still showing "Limit reached" on other devices after a usage limit was lifted outside the session - Fixed the file card sometimes missing in the Claude iOS app when Claude sent a single file - Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing with no explanation when the server keeps refusing to renew model access: the runner now retries sooner and posts a warning in the session - Fixed `/permissions` in cloud sessions replying only that it isn't available; it now says where the session's rules live and how to change them - Fixed cloud sessions losing session-scoped deny and ask permission rules, such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds, when the session moves to a new worker - Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the session when you typed three messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session - Fixed background tasks that keep running after `/clear` disappearing from the task list in Claude Code on the web until another task started or ended - Fixed hidden commands appearing in the slash command menu of cloud sessions on mobile and web - Fixed a case where `/rewind` could restore or delete a file through a directory symlink - Fixed a case where a `sed` command could skip the permission check in accept-edits and auto mode - Fixed a case where `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` in managed settings was ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway's URL is set only there and server-managed settings can't be fetched - Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command from permission checks - Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and `disallowedTools` entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version) - Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree - Fixed self-hosted runners: `--trust-workspace false` now also stops hooks in the repository's settings files and skills from running - Fixed a case where idle background sessions started through a shell-exported LLM gateway left the gateway after an update - Fixed help links in `/status` and the auto mode billing notice opening only part of the address when they wrap - Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` was set. With it set, Claude Code now makes a TLS handshake with the configured API host after a certificate failure, through your http:// proxy if one is set; it sends no API request - Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting silently with status 0 when a first-run question gets no answer (scripts, services, batch jobs, Ctrl+C); it now says why and exits 1 - Fixed `claude remote-control` ignoring a piped `y` that has no newline after it at the first-run question; it now counts as a yes - Fixed `/rename` reporting plain success when the new name could not be saved to the session transcript; it now warns that the new name may not last - Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` not being substituted in a plugin-provided `subagentStatusLine` command, which can now reference the plugin's own scripts - Fixed `claude plugin update` and `/plugin` "Update now" not installing dependencies added by the new plugin version - Fixed subagents being told after compaction to expect a completion notice for background agents they neither started nor took over - Fixed a case where a background agent's later report was lost silently: the notification now says it was refused and how to ask for it - Improved config saves on Windows: Claude Code waits longer for a file another program has open, so a kill during a save is less likely to leave `~/.claude.json` empty - Improved Claude in Chrome after a brief disconnect: it waits up to 6 seconds for the session's own browser to return before picking another - Improved Claude in Chrome: `javascript_tool` results of up to 60,000 characters now stay in the conversation instead of being saved to a file - Improved `claude purge` and the clean-up of old sessions to retry a folder that could not be fully deleted, and to report it as an error if it remains - Improved the refusal for a path outside the working directories on macOS and Windows: when only its letter case differs from a path inside them, the message names that spelling - Improved the contrast of faint gray secondary text, such as hints, details in `/stats`, `/model` and `/sandbox`, and rejected-action messages - Improved the artifact database error when an update targets a document that does not exist, and when the service pauses repeated refused writes - Improved the Claude apps gateway's warnings about a failed upstream call: each now names the upstream, not only its provider - Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: it reads "spend limit reached · resets Dec 1", then `admin.blocked_message` if one is set - Improved the `/model` picker: older models are now grouped under a "More models" row instead of being listed after the current ones - Improved `/context` at the terminal so the table Claude reads stays short: each list keeps its 10 largest rows, and MCP tools that load on demand share one row per server until they're called - Improved `/usage` in cloud sessions: it now links to Settings → Usage on claude.ai in a case where plan limits can't be shown - [VSCode] Improved the confirmation for removing a plugin marketplace: it now checks which of its plugins are installed at that moment - Changed MCP tasks to work in the terminal without feature-flag fetching (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`); set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1` to turn them off - Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the project - Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` so that settings files can no longer set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment - Changed a session's exact Bash or PowerShell ask rule to be refused, not asked about, when a broader deny rule covers the command - Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running `which` with flags outside a lookup/display set - Changed `--add-dir` directories to register plugin marketplaces only once that directory's own trust dialog has been accepted - Changed nested skill loading: with the Bash sandbox on, skills in `.claude/skills` folders below the starting folder load only if you start Claude Code there or `/cd` there - Changed self-paced `/loop` to end when a turn finishes without rescheduling, instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup; set `CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1` to keep the old behavior - Changed PostToolUse hooks to run, with up to 10 seconds to finish, on tool calls that finish after a new message interrupts the turn - Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a subagent: retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself - Changed cloud sessions to drop session-scoped allow rules at a move to a new worker when their deny and ask rules can't all be kept, so you may be asked again - Changed the automatic certificate repair behind a TLS-inspecting proxy: it no longer runs when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy variable set. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` to the proxy's http:// URL instead - Changed artifact database saves of rows others may have written: each file gets a hidden marker file, and existing files without one, earlier versions' exports among them, are left alone and reported - Updated `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` templates to match the Claude Console: removed Performance tuner, renamed two, and turned off web search and fetch in five whose prompts don't use them - Removed `shortcuts_list` and `shortcuts_execute`, which listed and started shortcuts saved in the extension, from Claude Code's built-in Claude in Chrome tools - Gateway: Added startup warnings for upstreams that mix AWS GovCloud with other upstreams, and for base URL variables in the gateway's environment - Gateway: Added a start-up log warning when managed settings name an Amazon Bedrock guardrail in a header, which the gateway doesn't forward, and no `bedrock` upstream sets a `guardrail` - Gateway: Fixed Claude Desktop offering a web search tool that always failed when every upstream is Amazon Bedrock - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner started with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` or `--configure-git` registering before a failed startup check made it exit; it now exits first - Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH` so that each repository in a session gets its own folder: a folder name already taken in the session gets `-2`, `-3`, … at the end - Self-hosted runner: Removed the end-of-session upload of a session's debug log; a failed session's log stays on the runner host unless `--remove-session-state` is set - [VSCode] Fixed prompts over 50,000 characters being cut off silently: the prompt now stays in the chat box with a notice, and a paste over the limit is refused with a notice - [VSCode] Fixed a click on the survey or "Report a problem" buttons sending the unfinished prompt - [VSCode] Fixed cloud sessions opened from the extension's Web tab bringing back turns that `/clear`, or Retry or Edit of a typed prompt, had removed - [VSCode] Fixed a deleted session's file coming back when that session was renamed in the extension - [VSCode] Fixed Claude carrying out an unapproved plan after a window reload: a step interrupted in plan mode now stops with a notice when the session comes back in another permission mode - [VSCode] Improved the "not signed in" message behind a Claude apps gateway: it now looks like an error and has a Sign in link - [VSCode] Changed links in Claude's replies that point at Claude sign-in, connector or API addresses to show as text with the address, instead of opening in the browser - [VSCode] Fixed a possible chat panel freeze when a dropped item's path contains a very long run of "/" characters - [VSCode] Fixed the `claude-vscode.toggleDictation` command starting dictation in every open Claude view at once; it now acts only in the view you are using, and a second press stops it - [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down while a reply with many unclosed `$$` math fences, each shorter than the last, streams in - [VSCode] Improved the chat panel's diagnostics tool for large workspaces: it leaves out files with no problems, returns compact JSON, and accepts an optional minimum severity - [Cloud sessions] Fixed scheduled tasks silently dropping a connector named memory: runs now keep it, mounted under that name plus a short suffix - [Cloud sessions] Fixed Send now on a waiting message in cloud sessions ending running background agents; they now keep running - [Cloud sessions] Improved the stalled-setup warning on self-hosted environments: its link now prefers your organization's default or an environment with a live runner, and names it - [Code Review] Changed unlinking a GitHub organization to also turn off its All repositories setting in Code Review; it stays off after you relink until you turn it back on - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag setup blocking launch when the channel list couldn't fully load; admins can now launch without picking a channel - [Claude Tag] Added a Claude Tag row to the Models admin page for Enterprise orgs with Claude Tag connected, linking to where its model defaults are managed - [Claude Tag] Fixed saving auto mode allow rules in Claude Tag admin settings overwriting another admin's changes; the save is now refused with a message

item.title: v2.1.318
item.description: - Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session - Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution - Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent - Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`) - Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends - Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314) - Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew - Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared - Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory - Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home - Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server - Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run - Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects - Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days - Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored - Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary - Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running - Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions - Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step` - Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message - Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited - Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process - Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary - Fixed `/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection - Fixed `/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404 - Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run - Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart - Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes - Fixed variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions - Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed - Fixed a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it - Fixed a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call - Fixed every connection failing when the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr - Fixed workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit - Fixed `/mcp` in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available - Fixed a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call - Fixed the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit - Fixed the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open - Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs - Fixed retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs `claude -p` with no `~/.claude.json` backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one - Fixed the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files - Fixed tokens from `setup-token` being refused at start on machines with `forceLoginOrgUUID`, when the token belongs to a permitted organization - Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551) - Fixed an empty `~/.claude.json` with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing - Fixed the restore command printed for a damaged or missing `~/.claude.json` naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file - Fixed the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in `claude -p` names `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token` - Improved how `~/.claude.json`, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy - Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders - Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema - Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in `/bin/bash` - Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step - Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep - Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal - Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check - Improved unattended runs (`claude -p`, SDK apps) to stop rewriting `~/.claude.json` on every run when nothing in it changed - Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view - Changed subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time" - Changed background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs - Changed subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response - Changed what a mod attaches at `prompt.submit` to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message - Changed `deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name - Changed the `/permissions` rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting - Changed `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out - Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped - Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (`external_account`) credentials file is about to expire - Gateway: Improved the log hints about `listen.trusted_proxies`: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to `X-Forwarded-For` itself - Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access - Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent - Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when `--release-idle-session-min` is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as `0`) - Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: `ok session=…` now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with `reason=…` after `jti=…`, and `nack session=…` ends its fields with `reason=…` after `retryable=…`; update scripts that match `retryable=true:` or `retryable=false:` - Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder - Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)" - [VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute - [VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view - [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails - [Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository - [Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH - [Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden - [Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: `gh run view --log` and `gh api` log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect - [Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again - [Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory - [Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name - [Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in Claude Tag admin setup; pressing Escape in the connect form no longer also closes the Add dialog - [Code Review] Improved the Code Review analytics page to retry once after a server or network failure, then show a Try again banner instead of empty cards

item.title: v2.1.317
item.description: - Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them - Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network - Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run - Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do - Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view - Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans - Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group - Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions - Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions - Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged) - Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run - Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab - Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page - Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps - Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls - Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating - Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request - Fixed auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder - Fixed skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk - Fixed `/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it - Fixed screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode - Fixed a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block - Fixed Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server - Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed - Fixed edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again - Fixed old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources` - Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message - Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval - Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off - Fixed Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which - Fixed Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete - Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting - Fixed self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval - Fixed "Prompt is too long" after automatic compaction in sessions whose very large CLAUDE.md changed since it was last sent - Fixed high memory use and slow startup in headless sessions with many plugins that register commands - Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials - Fixed API requests failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" behind some TLS-inspecting proxies after a root certificate renewal - Fixed very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request - Fixed a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages - Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model - Fixed `/artifacts` and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own - Fixed Claude treating partial Grep and Glob results as complete when a search hit its time limit - Fixed OpenTelemetry exports to an `https://` endpoint through a proxy never being sent when they started while another export was still in progress - Fixed a flood of connection attempts to a proxy that blocks (HTTP 403) OpenTelemetry exports to an `http://` endpoint - Fixed OpenTelemetry exports hanging indefinitely behind a proxy that never answers; they now time out after 10 seconds, or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` up to 30 seconds - Fixed resumed sessions telling Claude again about a file change it already knew about - Fixed Claude sometimes not using a built-in tool in a resumed session after an earlier call failed because the tool was switched off - Fixed `/remote-control` answering "Unknown command" instead of saying that Remote Control is turned off by the `disableRemoteControl` setting - Fixed agent team teammates in tmux or iTerm2 panes starting in auto mode when the lead session was in manual mode - Fixed a background session sometimes losing a just-made change of permission mode when it was upgraded or retired - Fixed Ctrl+C stopping all running background agents when pressed to clear typed text at the prompt - Fixed /feedback showing "Enter to confirm" while a report is being sent - Fixed child processes of a stopped shell command sometimes being sent SIGTERM twice, which could make some programs skip their cleanup - Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session sharing that session's ID: it wrote into the session's transcript, and a restart could resume the wrong conversation - Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session generating a title of its own and sending it to that session - Improved the error shown on Microsoft Foundry when Azure credentials can't be loaded: it now says to check or refresh them, and reports as `cloud_credential_error` - Improved `/design-sync` to say up front when your design system has moved to Claude, and stop before building instead of failing at upload - Improved the startup error when a required Claude apps gateway can't be reached: it points to the network instead of a sign-in, and says when the gateway's TLS certificate can't be verified - Improved the "Resume this session with" hint shown at exit to repeat the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume` - Improved how self-hosted runners recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a runner's next poll now opens a new connection instead of reusing the one that failed - Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a session now opens new connections instead of reusing the one that failed - Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover when connections stop answering: after a heartbeat gets no answer, a session now opens new connections instead of trying each idle one in turn - Changed SendMessage so a message to a running background agent arrives earlier: its running command moves to the background, without being stopped - Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level - Changed exit to skip the "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors - Changed the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill to offer once, after a mod you built works, to help share the mod - Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content - Windows: Fixed every tool call being refused on some volumes where the native path lookup fails; the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead - Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit - Gateway: Fixed the status line and `/usage` showing a developer's own spend limit as 100% used after their group's pooled budget ran out - Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch - Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)" - [VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered - [VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error - [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network - [VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word - [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group - [VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised - [VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off - [Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen - [Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing - [Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret - [Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default - [Remote Control] Fixed the next message to an idle session going unanswered after you restart `claude remote-control`, when you sent it within a minute of your previous message - [Claude Tag] Changed newly pasted artifact links in Slack to show a simpler card with an Open button that opens the artifact in Claude, instead of Slack's side panel

item.title: v2.1.316
item.description: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off - Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's - Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first - Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt - Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup - Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived - Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell - Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported - Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute - Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted - Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region - Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field - Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in - Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them - Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review - Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them - Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup` - Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict - Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off - Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1` - Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`) - Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them - Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window - Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound - Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows - Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved - Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals - Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine - Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined - Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list - Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow - Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects - Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each - Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts - Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused - [VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed - [VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal - [VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]` - [VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors - [VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits" - [Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it - [Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date - [Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them - [Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff - [Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM - [Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app - [Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run - [Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings - [Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

item.title: v2.1.314
item.description: - Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode - Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too - Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text - Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired - Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses - Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1 - Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting - Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family - Fixed repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers - Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor - Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out - Fixed `claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH - Fixed extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy - Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once - Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions - Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download - Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model - Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached - Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task) - Fixed background and cloud sessions started with Ultracode turning it back on at their next start after it had been switched off - Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed - Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters - Fixed background diff refreshes briefly taking the repository's index lock, which could make a git command run at the same moment fail with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists" - Fixed markdown tables jumping between grid and stacked layouts on half-typed rows while streaming, and long tables falling back to raw pipes - Fixed the /resume picker showing the text of CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md as a session's title when the session only ran slash commands - Fixed `/btw` answering from the main conversation when asked from a subagent's open transcript - Fixed pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine doing nothing silently; the prompt now says to copy the file over and paste its path - Fixed `claude remote-control` sessions that failed to start when the session service was slow for a moment: the worker's registration is now retried with growing waits - Fixed model switches over Remote Control that take over 8 seconds getting a "still pending" error instead of the final result - Fixed the `sandbox.excludedCommands` setting description saying listed commands always run outside the sandbox; it now says every command in a call must match an entry - Fixed shell and MCP calls that auto mode, a deny rule or a PreToolUse hook blocked, or that otherwise did not run, reading as if they ran in a collapsed tool group - Fixed sandbox protections not applying to a worktree entered by `claude -p --resume` or `--continue` - Fixed hooks matching Bash not running on shell commands started by the Monitor tool; such hooks can block or ask, but not approve or rewrite those commands - Fixed a settings file excluded with `--setting-sources` still supplying some settings, such as auto mode rules and saved permission consents - Fixed auto mode reporting a call as blocked, and listing it in `/permissions`, when its safety check gave no verdict - Fixed a Claude apps gateway Vertex upstream hanging for minutes when a Google token endpoint accepts the connection and never answers - Fixed the Claude apps gateway's start-up warning for a deprecated Claude Desktop key that it still serves as written saying "stops being accepted" after the key's end date - Fixed `/upgrade` opening the browser and starting a new login for plans billed through the App Store or Google Play; it now says where to change the plan - Fixed `--resume`, and rewinding past a switch to another model after a refusal, moving a session on a model name Claude Code doesn't recognize to a different model - Fixed requests failing when a gateway or cloud provider refuses one of Claude Code's beta headers by name: the request is sent again without it - Fixed model IDs spelled with a dot behind an LLM gateway, such as `claude-opus-4.8`, being treated as an older model with the wrong context window, output limit, effort, thinking mode and cost - Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stray "Compacted (ctrl+o to see full summary)" row after /compact - Fixed the cloud sessions tip and the Remote Control idle notice showing when an organization's policy turns those features off - Fixed a resumed claude.ai cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when the previous worker stopped just after receiving a new chat's files - Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions silently dropping a PDF's text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and where to read on - Fixed Claude being told only that a command was declined after you stopped it with Esc or Stop in a cloud session or the IDE; it now also hears that the command may have run - Fixed blank lines at the top of a code block disappearing when the code block opens a quote - Fixed a blank line appearing above some `⎿` rows in the transcript view (Ctrl+O) - Fixed vim mode `dw`, `dW`, `yw` and `yW` carrying on past the end of the line, and made `w` and `W` stop on empty lines - Fixed x and Enter in the agent panel sometimes acting on the wrong agent when another agent started or finished - Fixed pasted text and dragged-in files being lost in Claude's question dialog unless the "Other" row had focus - Fixed pasted text being lost when a row in the prompt footer was selected - Fixed vim mode `p` over a character selection ignoring whether the yanked text was whole lines - Fixed vim mode `aw` and `iw` taking the line break at the end of a line - Fixed ↓ selecting footer items hidden by the ? help menu, the command list or a paste hint - Fixed Esc on a command's panel, such as `/btw`, also interrupting the subagent whose transcript is open - Fixed the welcome header in fullscreen mode showing the session's model while viewing a subagent or teammate that runs on a different model - Fixed the fullscreen transcript being left mid-conversation after "Restore conversation" in the rewind menu while scrolled up - Fixed a rare case where a deleted session could reappear in the resume list as an almost empty entry - Fixed prompts containing tags such as `<bash-stdout>` or `<local-command-stdout>` not being acknowledged to a local stream-json host - Fixed sessions staying untitled when the first prompt failed (for example on a usage limit) and the conversation continued afterward - Fixed the skill file watcher checking every removed skill kept in `~/.claude/skills/.trash`, which added file system load that grew with each removal - Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks for permission or a plan decision, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable - Fixed background sessions that fail to start being reported as a deleted daemon binary when the binary is still on disk - Fixed the tip and idle reminder about push notifications appearing when the push settings in `/config` are hidden or your organization has turned off Remote Control - Fixed `~/.claude/skills/.trash` and `~/.claude/plugins/.trash` growing without limit: each now holds about 1024 entries, whatever `cleanupPeriodDays` says - Fixed the Bash edit diff listing a whole file as changed when a CRLF file under git's line-ending conversion was re-saved unchanged or had one line edited - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an idle session moving to another runner instead of pausing when the runner's request to pause it lost its connection before Anthropic answered - Improved memory use in long headless and SDK turns that run many subagents: the parent session no longer keeps each subagent's tool results until the turn ends - Improved prompt history: Ctrl+R now matches text inside collapsed `[Pasted text]` pills - Improved the `/design-sync` upload prompt to show the folder, the project and the files it will upload or delete - Improved `/permissions` review tab, now called Recently blocked: the footer says what Esc will do with marked rows - Improved auto mode's blocked calls: messages name the command, say Claude may retry and auto mode checks again, and point to `/permissions` to review - Improved permission prompts: a long reason takes fewer rows, so it pushes the command being approved off the screen on fewer terminals - Improved the cloud session error shown while a request refused for your claude.ai login is still being retried: it now also suggests `claude auth login` - Improved the behavior of stored claude.ai, Team, and Enterprise logins when MDM and remote settings differ on base URL or `apiKeyHelper` - Improved `/config` in agent view to say how to stop agent view opening by default - Improved session auto-titles: a session that starts with a skill or a prompt-based command such as `/security-review` now gets a title from it instead of staying untitled - Improved `--resume` speed and memory use on damaged transcripts - Improved `/context` speed in sessions with ten thousand or more MCP tools - Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when a session's branch isn't on the git remote: it now covers a never-pushed branch, says how to fix each case, and no longer suggests retrying - Updated the `/claude-api` skill: its Datadog setup for API tracing now sends the `dd-llmobs-enabled: true` header, as the Console does, and its `ant` install instructions drop the outdated macOS `xattr` step - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to advise printing y-axis tick labels in full under 10,000, and horizontal ones in full under a million where they fit - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to answer donut and pie chart requests with ranked bars or a segmented bar that prints its values - Changed Claude's file tools to ask before editing the local copy of your organization's server-managed settings, as they do for your settings files - Changed `/ultrareview` to check workspace trust before it runs git, as `claude ultrareview` does - Changed the Bash tool's shell to clear any inherited `which` alias or function and to stop passing exported `which`/`unsetenv` functions to commands, so `which` is the system command or zsh builtin - Changed `/permissions` Recently blocked to refuse approving a call you can't read in full, including one the terminal is too short to show - Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a hook's allow of an MCP tool call now counts as no answer, so the classifier or a permission prompt decides - Changed hook `if` conditions such as `Monitor(tail *)` to match the Monitor tool's shell commands as `Bash(tail *)` matches Bash's - Changed the `claude-api` skill to ask to read a Managed Agents workflow run's workflow before changing the agent to improve that run - Changed flagged requests to retry on another model, not end in a refusal, when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `availableModels` or `deniedModels` leaves only an older Opus model, or none - Changed idle compaction to also run for subscribers with telemetry turned off, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and LLM gateways once the one-hour prompt cache is on - Changed `FORCE_HYPERLINK=false` (also `no` and `off`) to turn hyperlinks off instead of on - macOS: Changed `git grep` in most commands that Claude runs to use the C locale, to avoid a reported memory leak in macOS's regex library on files that aren't valid UTF-8 - [VSCode] Fixed "Clear authentication" for MCP servers reporting success when the saved sign-in could not be removed - [VSCode] Fixed missing spinner and Stop button while a queued message's hooks run - [VSCode] Fixed session group changes that cannot be saved, such as a delete, failing silently; an error notification now appears - [VSCode] Fixed Cmd+F / Ctrl+F not opening the find widget in the plan preview tab - [VSCode] Fixed the voice dictation shortcut (Ctrl+D) doing nothing under non-Latin keyboard layouts such as Russian, Greek or Hebrew - [VSCode] Fixed missed one-time saved scheduled tasks being deleted without asking when the extension opened without a chat - [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT` to also stop the extension adding the Claude in Chrome instructions to a session's messages; the browser tools stay available - [Cloud sessions] Added an Include completed button to the Scheduled tasks page when finished one-off tasks are the only ones hidden, so you can show them without opening the Sort menu - [Cloud sessions] Fixed recently used self-hosted environments never appearing among the recent environments on the new session card - [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions reporting uncommitted changes every turn after Claude moved a branch to a commit it had pushed from another worktree - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings squeezing its content out of view in very short windows or at high zoom; the dialog now scrolls - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the permission mode picker staying on Auto after a running cloud or Remote Control session refused the switch; it now shows the mode in use and tells you - [Cloud sessions] Improved scheduled tasks: runs in Anthropic's cloud now load the plugins enabled on your claude.ai account - [Cloud sessions] Improved Test connection for GitHub Enterprise in admin settings to also connect the way cloud sessions do, and to warn you when that second test fails - [Cloud sessions] Improved cloud session transcripts: a rename row now names the new title, and repository and environment lists show as a table instead of one line of JSON - [Cloud sessions] Changed cloud sessions from the web, desktop and mobile apps to start even when a setup script exits with an error, instead of failing to start - [Remote Control] Fixed the permission mode button in Remote Control sessions showing the wrong mode until you typed; while your computer is online it now shows the real mode on open - [Claude Tag] Added a dismissible link to the Claude Tag API docs on the Bundles and Channels tabs in admin settings, for Enterprise organizations with Slack connected - [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` giving up after one failed workspace check in channels shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces; it now retries, then asks you to run it again - [Claude Tag] Fixed a second confirmation DM and channel note when you connect your Claude account from Slack twice from the same link within a few minutes - [Claude Tag] Fixed follow-up messages in Slack showing no sign of progress while Claude's session waits for a self-hosted runner; Claude now posts a wait notice in the thread - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes not answering a tag in its own thread in Slack Connect channels where both organizations have installed Claude - [Claude Tag] Fixed Retry on plugin and skill pages in Claude Tag admin settings discarding unsaved access changes after a failed load; your edits now stay in place - [Claude Tag] Fixed the repositories control in Claude Tag admin settings showing the same action twice; its menu now lists only what the button doesn't already do

item.title: v2.1.312
item.description: - Added `oidc.user_id_claim` to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid` - Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does - Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension - Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start;
